compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: one new qualification markdown plus an appended delta-log section in the matrix, no source, schema, API, MCP, test, or config change? Any altered adapter behavior or claimed contract change?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient and honest: binary SHA and command outputs recorded, harness described (throwaway script, confined mkdtemp root, committed adapter imports), no committed test doubles presented as upstream proof, fixture suite acknowledged as the CI story, graft/hygiene green, CI will re-verify at exact head?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: documentation-only change cannot affect runtime; are recorded SHAs and counts exact; is the delta log append-only with no row rewrites?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the VectorCraft record and delta log: PhotoCraft qualification, transplant code, adapter behavior changes, or product features? Are those explicitly deferred?

security.instructions: Does the grain leak secrets (no tokens in the record; binary SHA only), redistribute donor code (no binary or source committed; /tmp artifacts outside the repo), weaken adapter confinement (unchanged: disabled-by-default, absolute paths, pin enforcement), or over-claim (refused surfaces explicitly uninvoked, platform/commit scoped)?
